title: A weak GPU: pixel ratio, powerPreference and an adaptive budget
question: How does GA's neck behave on a weak GPU (SwiftShader, Chromium's software rasterizer, standing in for one) at pixel ratios 0.5, 1, 2 and GA's 3; does powerPreference change the adapter on this machine; and does an adaptive controller that lowers the pixel ratio to hold a 16.7 ms budget converge?
hypothesis: GPU time follows the pixel count, so GA's pixel ratio of 3 costs about 9x a ratio of 1 on a weak GPU; this machine has one enabled adapter, so powerPreference changes nothing; the controller settles at the largest ratio under budget within 60 frames.

predictions.metric: wall ms per frame on SwiftShader, pixel ratio 3 against 1
adapter for low-power and high-performance on this machine
adaptive controller's pixel ratio after 60 frames, 16.7 ms budget
predictions.predicted: RTX 5080: its maximum of 2; SwiftShader: 1 or lower
